svg.text: World 1 | element Shadow | status review | hero: Stem
height 3.44 studs | 62 blocks | 790 triangles | bevel 0.125 x 2 | 1 stud = 67 px
Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `hearty` (Epic eye), 28 x 12 px at 16 a stud, 5 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Shadow. VFX: kept on the body (Epic): Effects.luau's pumpkin-orange Light (FF9F1C) at
the Mouth pulsing every 2.4 s, so the grin glows from inside; a ghost-white mist (E9E2FF)
pooling at the Feet at 3 a second; ember flickers (FFB347) rising off the Top at 2.5 a second;
its signature Burst, a ring of twelve violet wisps (C77DFF) every 5 s and on the flourish (the
boo); a violet Sparkle at the Tail every 3 s; a Hover idle of 0.35 studs over 3 s. On the model
the tatter tips, the little lantern's face, the lock's keyhole and the back emblem's eyes are
violet glow cells. The rig adds the motion and the flourish: the arms wave, the hem and tatters
stir, the stem sways, a little jack-o'-lantern floats and turns at its side, and every 10 s it
says boo (a squash, a hop and a full turn, the arms flung wide)
